findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "markdown_lane_self_report" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "markdown" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: markdown_lane_self_report, whoami, example, check_markdown_lane, explain_llms_txt · Private data: markdown_lane_self_report, whoami, example, explain_llms_txt · Public sink: markdown_lane_self_report, whoami, example · Destructive: example.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
